latin: Nec particularis affirmatiua possibilis conuertitur semper in affirmatiuam possibilem, nec necessaria particularis affirmatiua in necessariam, ut credidit Aristoteles.
translation: Contrary to what Aristotle believed, a particular possible affirmative does not always convert into another possible affirmative, nor does a particular necessary affirmative always convert into a necessary one.
